learner.prediction_scope: Excludes new front matter and grammatical index; assumes unchanged standalone component pagination and no final blank verso after the last component.

key.prediction_scope: Excludes new front matter and grammatical index; assumes unchanged standalone component pagination and no final blank verso after the last component.

page_count_method: Counted Xpdf raw-text form-feed page delimiters from every current retained PDF; no -nopgbrk option.
status: complete independent component inventory and assembly proposal
role_limits: Assembly inventory only. No prior source, master, TeX, PDF, acceptance record, register, Beads or Git state edited. Existing linguistic and visual acceptance is identified, not re-certified by this inventory.

answer_separation.learner: Only pronunciation learner, Units1–18 student bodies, optional sound history and both reference glossaries.
answer_separation.key: Only pronunciation practice key and Units1–18 answer-key bodies.
answer_separation.boundary: Separate by the positive component allowlists. Do not filter prose by words such as answer: accepted learner worked examples, supplied help and glossary entries remain part of the course. No answer-key.md or answer-key.tex component belongs in the learner assembly.

constraints.finding: All41 components use ../book-layout.tex; no body-level external file inputs exist.
constraints.action: Load the unchanged shared layout once in the full-volume preamble; extract only the retained body between the single document markers.

constraints.finding: Six exact local preamble setups exist; itempara and reserve have materially different implementations. Unit1 also defines continuation.
constraints.action: Retain the component-specific setup inside a local group. Preserve all manual and conditional page-control commands; do not replace custom reserve or needspace implementations with a generic package.

constraints.finding: Ligatures=TeXOff is present in34 bodies and absent in learners1–4 and keys1–3. Glossary text uses local10.5/13.2 sizing and two-column settings.
constraints.action: Keep font features, sizes, ragged settings, column separation and emergency stretch component-local. Do not impose later-unit ligature settings on all components.

constraints.finding: The shared article layout is twoside, with unequal inner/outer margins and alternating running headers.
constraints.action: Start every component recto to preserve original page parity. Use explicit blank versos where required. Flush the final component page before closing its local group so its running title and settings remain active at shipout.

constraints.finding: No body page resets, labels, refs, pagerefs, hypertargets, hyperlinks, footnotes, running marks or macro definitions were found. All body begingroup/endgroup counts balance. Existing manual pagination is3 newpage plus65 clearpage; conditional placement includes2355 reserve and3642 needspace calls.
constraints.action: Use roman front matter then a single Arabic body sequence per volume. Preserve all retained body controls; add uniquely named assembly anchors/counters externally rather than resetting component pages.

constraints.finding: All53 explicit pdfbookmark commands are in the two glossaries. outline-B00001 and outline-B01321 collide across them; the latter means OE T versus English P.
constraints.action: Namespace every explicit bookmark destination by component, not just the two collisions. Use the complete per-component bookmark ledger to retain the first glossary title at component level and nest Entries, letter headings and quoted-errors material appropriately. Avoid a duplicate component/title bookmark.

constraints.finding: Shared layout already loads unicode hyperref and Cambria; only the glossary preamble adds multicol.
constraints.action: Load multicol once in the outer preamble. Move only package loading out of the glossary local setup; retain raggedcolumns and6mm column separation locally. Do not load a second documentclass, font stack, geometry or hyperref.

constraints.finding: Numbered section text is chiefly embedded in starred section titles; existing bodies have no course-page cross-reference commands.
constraints.action: Build the contents and grammar index from external metadata tied to component/section anchors. Preserve visible titles, task IDs and section numbering. Resolve page references after compilation; do not hard-code standalone page numbers into the new index.

recommended_build: Verify every ledger hash before extraction; preserve exact normalized body text and stable source-line mapping. The recorded current raw hashes and LF body hashes distinguish content extraction from line-ending differences.

Create two explicit positive inclusion manifests using volumes.learner.component_ids and volumes.key.component_ids. Build both with LuaLaTeX and the retained shared layout; load only required new navigation/index infrastructure plus multicol once.

Give each component a local group, its exact setup, a locally renewed runningtitle, and a recto start. Flush pending pages before group end. Isolate glossary custom macro names from any index package that might define needspace.

Add zero-height component/section anchors and external contents/index entries. Prefix glossary destinations and adjust bookmark hierarchy through a bounded wrapper or recorded metadata-only transform; all retained source text remains unchanged.

Use roman-numbered front matter and continuously numbered Arabic content per volume. Record inserted blank versos and source-component/local-page to global-page mappings. Run enough LuaLaTeX/index passes for contents, references and outlines to stabilize.

Compare every assembled component's visible text in order against its accepted standalone text, ignoring only identified running pagination/navigation additions. Prove positive key exclusion from the learner list; avoid word-based removal of accepted examples or reference material.

Render source and assembled pages with identical settings. For reused-page acceptance, compare decoded image pixels from page top through all body content, excluding only the changed footer. Confirm the crop covers every table/body line; inspect every new footer, all front matter/index, blank-verso behavior and every nonidentical body page.

Save final source identities, TeX/PDF identities, resolved page map, duplicate-destination/undefined-reference checks, content parity and honestly scoped visual acceptance. Retained standalone PDFs and prior records remain immutable.
